tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smin grol dpal skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ 1$0000300khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur// zung 'jug he ru ka dpal zhi dang khro// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// rdo rje gsum gyi rang gzugs rigs gsum mgon// las kyi dbang mo rang byung badz+ra he// dpal gyi seng ge lung bstan rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// ye shes rnam brgyad gdod gnas rig pa 'dzin// kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon po thod phreng rtsal// gangs can grub mchog tshom bu nyi shu lngar// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// srid zhi'i che mchog tshangs pa lha'i me tog /dbyings phyug gsang ba'i tshogs rje bde chen rgyal// dgongs pa mngon gyur lha sras rol pa rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// zab gter mdzod 'dzin mchog gyur bde chen gling*// bka' babs lung thob las can chos kyi bdag /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// klong dgu'i rang bzhin dpal chen gtso dang 'khor// gnas gsum ḍā ki dam tshig bka' yi gnyer// snang srid gzhir bzhengs yongs grub dkyil 'khor la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// phyi nang sgrub gsang dbang gis rgyud smin cing*// bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen lam rim mtha' ru phyin// thun mong las dang dngos grub thogs med 'phrul// zung 'jug mchog la tshe 'dir sbyor bar shog /dgongs pa rnam dgu'i lta ba'i rdzong thob cing*// thun mong thun min bsgom pa'i 'phrang las sgrol// spyod pa dam tshig srog rtsa rab brtan nas// lnga phrag lnga ldan byang chub mngon byed shog
/ngo bo rang rtsal gzhi don lam gsum dang*// snying pos myur rtogs sbyor bzhis bogs thon cing*// sgrol bas gegs sel rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i 'bras// mthar phyin kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob shog /

ces pa'ang khyab bdag bla ma gter chen rin po che nyid kyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du bka'i gnang ba ched du bstsal pa ltar/ pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/// /
